opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from the humanities and social sciences based at a UK university or recognised research organisation; British citizens or EEA nationals; must have completed their doctorate between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027; must not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year award for early‑career researchers to undertake an independent research project leading to a publishable output.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑resident lead applicants holding a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or IRO, working in the humanities or social sciences; co‑applicants may be UK or overseas.
opportunities.summary: Award to develop quantitative, data‑science, digital‑humanities or language skills; up to 12 months, max £10,000.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a permanent or fixed‑term UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation position; must lead interdisciplinary collaboration across Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding (up to 24 months) for established researchers to pursue cross‑disciplinary, curiosity‑driven projects.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher (early‑career to senior) in the humanities or social sciences; must partner with a GLAM or performing‑arts organisation.
opportunities.summary: Public‑engagement awards (up to £8,000) to develop innovative projects with cultural institutions.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based PI from humanities or social sciences (post‑doctoral or above) with a long‑term UK appointment; must involve overseas co‑applicants and genuine interdisciplinary collaboration.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year interdisciplinary projects on mobilities, up to £300,000 (80% FEC).

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences; must be based at a UK institution.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships (up to £150,000) hosted at DGAP in Berlin, focusing on security, defence, Indo‑European relations, technology, AI, strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding (up to £4,000) to support additional needs of applicants or award‑holders (e.g., equipment, caring costs, accessibility). Applications reviewed monthly.

opportunities.title: Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027 (Alexander von Humboldt Foundation)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers affiliated with UK or German institutions; must be in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funding for early‑career scholars to attend a three‑day interdisciplinary symposium on ‘Humans and Nature’, including travel and accommodation.
